title: This is an official collection of Claude plugins from Anthropic for financial services workflows
description:
This is an official collection of Claude plugins from Anthropic for financial services workflows. It covers investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management.The plugins include skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and MCP connectors for workflows like research reports, comparable company analysis, deal sourcing, and portfolio tracking. Everything is just markdown and JSON, no code, no infrastructure.

https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services-plugins

#github #opensource
